full_diagnostic_meaning: Normal ECG (Normal sinus rhythm, normal heart rate 60-100 bpm, normal PR/QRS/QT intervals, absence of chamber enlargement or repolarization abnormalities)
ptbxl_source_field_and_logic: scp_codes contains 'NORM' with likelihood >= 50, strictly in absence of conflicting target pathology
chapman_source_field_and_logic: Sole SNOMED code 426783006 (Sinus Rhythm) with zero other clinical or morphological diagnostic codes
mimic_source_field_and_logic: Explicit machine report statement 'normal ecg' or 'normal electrocardiogram' without contradiction
positive_definition: Established normal variant across all vectors
annotation_modality_notes: PTB-XL: Cardiologist confirmed; Chapman: Physician SNOMED; MIMIC: GE Marquette 12SL automated report statement

full_diagnostic_meaning: Atrial Fibrillation (Irregular baseline fibrillatory waves and irregularly irregular ventricular response)
mimic_source_field_and_logic: Explicit machine report statement matching 'atrial fibrillation' or 'afib'
annotation_modality_notes: High inter-cohort concordance; rhythm finding observable on rhythm leads

full_diagnostic_meaning: Complete Right Bundle Branch Block (QRS duration >= 120 ms, rsR-prime pattern in V1/V2, wide slurred S wave in I and V6)
ptbxl_source_field_and_logic: scp_codes contains 'CRBBB' (complete RBBB; incomplete IRBBB excluded from positive target)
mimic_source_field_and_logic: Explicit machine report statement 'right bundle branch block', 'complete right bundle branch block', or 'rbbb' with fascicular block
positive_definition: Complete right ventricular conduction delay (QRS >= 120 ms)
annotation_modality_notes: Morphologically requires lead V1 for definitive diagnostic confirmation

full_diagnostic_meaning: Complete Left Bundle Branch Block (QRS duration >= 120 ms, broad notched R wave in lateral leads I/aVL/V5/V6, absent septal Q in lateral leads, rS in V1)
ptbxl_source_field_and_logic: scp_codes contains 'CLBBB' (complete LBBB; incomplete ILBBB excluded from positive target)
mimic_source_field_and_logic: Explicit machine report statement 'left bundle branch block', 'complete left bundle branch block', or 'lbbb'
positive_definition: Complete left ventricular conduction delay (QRS >= 120 ms)
annotation_modality_notes: Requires broad lateral leads and V1; excludes secondary repolarization changes from negative classification

full_diagnostic_meaning: Sinus Bradycardia (Sinus rhythm originating from SA node with resting heart rate < 60 bpm)
positive_definition: Sinus rhythm with ventricular rate < 60 bpm
annotation_modality_notes: Rate-dependent diagnosis. Records with junctional/ventricular bradycardia masked as unknown

full_diagnostic_meaning: Sinus Tachycardia (Sinus rhythm originating from SA node with resting heart rate > 100 bpm)
positive_definition: Sinus rhythm with ventricular rate > 100 bpm
annotation_modality_notes: Rate-dependent diagnosis. Ectopic atrial or ventricular tachycardias masked as unknown

full_diagnostic_meaning: First-Degree Atrioventricular Block (Prolongation of PR interval > 200 ms with constant 1:1 AV conduction)
mimic_source_field_and_logic: Definite report statement matching '1st degree a-v block', 'first degree a-v block', or 'prolonged pr interval' without 'borderline' qualifier
positive_definition: Constant PR interval > 200 ms on 12-lead acquisition
annotation_modality_notes: Higher-degree AV blocks (Mobitz I/II, 3AVB) masked as unknown to avoid false negatives

full_diagnostic_meaning: Myocardial Infarction (Evidence of acute, evolving, or chronic transmural/subendocardial ischemic myocardial injury or necrosis)
ptbxl_source_field_and_logic: Explicit anatomical infarction statements in scp_codes: IMI, ASMI, AMI, ALMI, ILMI, LMI, IPMI, PMI
mimic_source_field_and_logic: Definitive infarction report statements without equivocal qualifiers (e.g. 'inferior infarct - age undetermined', 'anterior infarct, old')
positive_definition: Pathological Q waves, ST elevations meeting criteria, or adjudicated necrosis statement
annotation_modality_notes: Pooled across anatomical territories; no anatomical sub-acronym is retained in Module 4 target space
